races.name: Human
races.notes: At floor end, one Skill at Rank 9 or less advances with Advantage. Spend Favor for Con-based DR when damaged; once daily use a non-Passive untrained Utility Skill as Rank 2; once per floor remove a Debuff, including Injuries. Timing and these conditional benefits are resolved at the table. Future level-gain Favor is automatic.

races.name: Amazonian
races.notes: Requires an existing Strength- or Dexterity-based Skill at Rank 5+. Receive a free Weapon Training Guild coupon each floor; issue and use coupons at the table. Optional gender/species limits are adjudicated by the GM.

races.name: Crocodilian
races.notes: Advantage when physically menacing someone with Intimidate; +1 to Skill Checks for an hour after a full meal; Disadvantage on Charisma-based Checks while Fatigued. Conditional effects are resolved at the table.

races.name: Igneous
races.notes: Once daily double Move for 20 seconds. Action: Con Check to deal 1d8+F Fire, 5ft Burst. No harsh-environment Survival Checks; breathe underwater and burrow. Lose one Health Bar slot on Inventory access (not Hotlist); Disadvantage concealing presence or nature. These actions, costs and conditional effects are manual.

races.name: Pterolykos
races.notes: Alien Race: cannot select Earth Classes. Fly for up to 50 seconds per scene; Disadvantage concealing emotion or presence; +1 Popularity on a Charisma Skill Critical Hit. Flight, Popularity and conditional checks are manual.

classes.name: Boring Ol’ Fighter
classes.notes: Access any Weapon Training Guild and receive one free training coupon each floor. Dodge grants a passive Evade Buff and later upgrades; apply passive ability bonuses and coupon rewards at the table.

classes.name: Pit Fighter
classes.notes: Award a Silver Earth Box with a guaranteed Earth Hobby Potion manually. Dodge/other passive ability effects, interrupt timing, Damage Effect conditions and upgrades remain table-adjudicated.

classes.name: Blizzardmancer
classes.notes: May use Aiming for single-target Ice Spells. Spell damage, rank upgrades and conditional Aiming are resolved at the table; casting uses the existing prepared-Spell and Mana workflow.

classes.name: Monster Truck Driver
classes.notes: Requires Driving Rank 5+. Earth-only Class. Moving in combat can increase the Health Bar threshold based on conveyance Move; on foot requires a prior Move Action. Manual special Action: Floor Rank + Dex, 1d12 Bludgeoning, 2d10+3ft Line; then Fatigued; Critical Fail on Natural 4 or less; 30-hour cooldown; add one die at Ranks 5/10/15. Once per combat when losing 2+ slots, roll 1d2: on 1 attacker loses a slot. Award the Silver Earth Box/Hobby Potion manually.

abilities.name: Diplomacy
abilities.description: Mediate between opposing parties with an Int-Opposed Check against the side with higher Int Mod. Resolve conditions and upgrades at the table.

abilities.name: Attack of Opportunity
abilities.description: Passive Interrupt. Requires a one-handed melee weapon with reach no greater than 5ft. Spend an Action to attack a foe leaving an adjacent space except via Step. Timing and upgrades are manual.

abilities.name: Dirty Fighting
abilities.description: Pugilism/Wrasslin’ Damage Effect. Apply Woozy; lose 1 Popularity on Critical Fail. Mark the Attack OR Damage Effect, never both. Conditions, cooldowns and upgrades are manual.

abilities.name: Powerful Strike
abilities.description: Foot Soldier, Noggin Nocker or Pugilism Damage Effect. Multiply base damage dice result by Rank before modifiers. 30-hour cooldown, improving by Rank. Mark Attack OR Effect, never both; resolve conditions and damage at the table.

abilities.name: Dodge
abilities.description: Passive +1 Evade Buff; upgrades at Ranks 5/10/15. Mark only when Evading below Rank 5; later increases require magic/training. Evade bonuses, special marking eligibility and upgrades are adjudicated at the table.

abilities.name: Gear Head
abilities.description: Limited Skill from Race/Class/item. Requires Engine Stand attachment to Engineering Table (2,000 gold). Build engines and vehicles using the entry’s crafting rules; resolve costs and upgrades at the table.

abilities.name: Pathfinder
abilities.description: HUD map zoom scales with Rank. Rank increases require magic or training. Saferoom/stairwell alerts and other upgrades are adjudicated at the table.

abilities.name: Ice Blast
abilities.description: Ice Attack Spell. Resolve damage and rank upgrades at the table.

abilities.name: Shield Block
abilities.description: Interrupt requiring a shield; not against AoE. Spend one Action for separate Checks vs physical Attacks. Success halves damage before DR. Shield wear, timing and upgrades are manual.

abilities.name: Zone of Control
abilities.description: Requires a Reach weapon. Once per round, spend an Action for an Interrupt Attack with Disadvantage when a foe first enters an adjacent space. Resolve timing and rank upgrades at the table.

abilities.name: Bite
abilities.description: Melee animal Strike; target must have an appendage to clamp onto. Resolve conditions and rank upgrades at the table.
